title: Time Loop PR
description: A oneshot for four level 3 players. Every encounter below is played from its log, CombatLogs/<id>.json, prepared with: python -m Combat.Tools.prepare_encounters --campaign time_loop_pr

encounters.title: Outside the Gates
encounters.description: An easy fight against a rival adventuring party: one tank, one healer, one control, one DPS.
encounters.difficulty: Low: 600 XP against the four level 3 players (Low starts at 600).

encounters.title: The Drunk Oxe
encounters.description: A tavern brawl: two bugbears, a pirate and a tiger.

encounters.title: The Square
encounters.description: Mirelle the vrock and the guards of the square.
encounters.difficulty: 3650 XP, about 2.3x the High budget of 1600.
